subject: SIGN clause
notes: kb/Work PB537 LANDED (wave 58). COBOL2422 when the usage of an elementary item whose entry WRITES the SIGN clause is other than display or national - its own USAGE clause or one inherited from a group (13.18.60.4 GR1: 01 G USAGE COMP. 05 A PIC S9(4) SIGN LEADING. is refused). A SIGN clause on a GROUP is not SR2's subject (it names 'an elementary item for which the SIGN clause is specified'), so 01 G USAGE COMP SIGN LEADING. is legal and GR1 applies the clause only to display/national subordinates (ApplyEffectiveSign).
